notes.title: EPISODE 2: River Ripper
notes.content:
[b]GAME INFO[/b]

     Hello everyone I am about to put another game out called River Ripper! Now I was originally planning to release Water Watch as the second episode but I got sidetracked and made this short little game. Water Watch is still going to come out but it may take some time. You can play my latest builds on the Water Watch Beta itch.io page. 



[b]ABOUT RIVER RIPPER[/b]

You go exploring your grandparents old neighborhood on a family visit at the middle of the night. You are in search of the old house in the woods. Roomer has it a killer has been hiding out there for years. Can you find out the secrets of the neighborhood? Use the brand new Killer Catcher device to detect if the killer is near by. When the device beeps be carful because the river ripper is just a few deadly feet away.
This game should only take a couple of minutes to beat so enjoy!



[b]TRAILER[/b]

   You can play by clicking play in the steam app and selecting between East Wood Carnival or River Ripper. By default through the desktop icon East Wood Carnival will launch.
